evidence.reason: `Outbox.spool()` persists the review after `validate()` without any record-size admission check. The supplied code shows no bound before `atomic(filename, canonical(value))`, so an oversized review can be durably written to `pending`. Because `GitLedger.publish()` rejects records above `RECORD_BYTES` before pushing, that pending record blocks later valid records until manually removed. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the spool/publish contract, not a new approval or protection requirement.
